description: Is it safe to pay this address? One check before sending or accepting crypto: OFAC SDN screen, who it is (exchange, issuer or verified contract name; mixers and fake claim contracts flagged), wallet age, first funder and large transfers on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (activity on Solana), plus a token's 0-100 risk score if given. Returns ok, caution or block with plain reasons. No chain given: it finds the busiest one. Not legal advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Address you are about to pay or receive from

chain.description: Chain of the payment. Omit it and a base58 address is checked on solana; a 0x address on the EVM chain where it (or the token) has the most transactions, reported in chainDetection

expect.description: What the address should be: eoa (a wallet), contract, or any (default); a mismatch gives caution

token.description: Token being paid or received (contract or mint on the same chain); adds its risk score

name: prepayment_safety_check
